skill.name: set-up-shopify-google-ads-conversion-tracking
skill.description: Set up and troubleshoot server-side Shopify purchase tracking in Google Ads through Product Metrics. Connect accounts, configure consent, and verify secondary conversion actions with a paid test order.
skill.summary: Configure and verify server-side Shopify purchase tracking in Google Ads through Product Metrics.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most alerts are documentation or scoped reads, not shell substitution or host reconnaissance. The workflow uses a remote API and offers an unpinned installer. The review also found gaps in account confirmation, browser handoffs, and tracking scope, but no evidence of credential theft or prompt injection.

remediation.issue: The optional installer does not pin the runner package or skill revision.
remediation.suggestion: Pin both components to reviewed versions or immutable revisions. Keep installation in a separate, user-approved step.

remediation.issue: The remote tool can operate through a generic API execution interface.
remediation.suggestion: Allowlist setup operations, use least-privilege credentials, and show the account and planned changes before requesting approval for any write.

remediation.issue: Browser handoffs and fallback instructions lack source verification requirements.
remediation.suggestion: Require HTTPS and verify the expected origin and action before sharing a URL. Prefer bundled, reviewed instructions over live fallback pages.

remediation.issue: The shared references include customer-data steps outside this skill's stated scope.
remediation.suggestion: Use conversion-only references. Require separate opt-in for Enhanced Conversions, Customer Match, or other ad channels, and state that order uploads depend on consent.

content.user_title: Set Up Shopify Conversion Tracking in Google Ads
content.value_statement: Browser-only tracking can miss paid Shopify orders. Use Product Metrics to configure server-side Google Ads tracking and verify it with a paid test order.
actual_capabilities: Reads Product Metrics setup status through its CLI or MCP server and identifies incomplete steps.
Guides Shopify app installation, store linking, and activation of the app embed.
Guides Google Ads client account linking, Merchant Center setup, and the Data Manager permission grant.
Explains how to select the consent provider that matches the storefront.
Guides creation of eight secondary actions for revenue, profit, customer type, and lifetime value.
Guides tracking tests and paid order checks, and explains how refunds and cancellations adjust conversions.
limitations: Live tracking requires an active Product Metrics subscription through Shopify, appropriate account access, and a linked Merchant Center account.
The user handles browser approvals, Shopify billing, and Google Ads changes that make an action primary.
Only eligible paid orders are sent. Consent settings can explain why conversion totals are lower than Shopify order totals.
This skill does not set up Enhanced Conversions, Customer Match, other ad channels, or bidding strategies.

use_cases.title: Set up tracking for a new store
use_cases.description: Link Shopify and Google Ads, configure the storefront consent provider, and verify tracking with a paid test order.

use_cases.title: Compare tracking before changing bidding goals
use_cases.description: Set up secondary actions alongside current purchase tracking so you can compare signals before choosing a primary action.

use_cases.title: Investigate missing conversions
use_cases.description: Check account access, consent settings, and a known paid test order before recommending configuration changes.

prompt_templates.title: List the setup requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: What accounts and permissions do I need to connect my Shopify store to Google Ads through Product Metrics?
prompt_templates.scenario: You are planning the setup and do not want any account changes.

prompt_templates.title: Check the current setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my Product Metrics setup without making changes. Tell me which Shopify and Google Ads steps are still incomplete.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare secondary conversion actions
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my consent provider and Google Ads client account. Show me the plan for eight secondary actions and ask before making changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: You want to test new actions alongside existing tracking.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a missing paid conversion
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate why my paid test order is missing from Google Ads. Check payment status, consent, account access, and tracking status without changing settings.
prompt_templates.scenario: A known paid test order is missing after setup.

output_examples.input: My Shopify app is connected. What is left before I can test conversions?
output: Shopify is connected. Google Ads still needs Data Manager access for the client account that runs your campaigns.
After you approve access, verify that Configure consent names your storefront banner. Then set up the secondary actions and run a tracking test.

output_examples.input: The tracking test says Listening, and my test order has not appeared.
output: Check whether Shopify marks the test order as paid. An unpaid test order is not sent.
If the order is paid, check that Configure consent matches the live banner. Review that test order without sharing customer details.

best_practices: Confirm the Shopify store, Product Metrics workspace, and Google Ads client account before approving changes.
Match the consent configuration to the storefront banner before verifying tracking.
Keep new actions secondary while comparing results, and use a known paid test order for verification.
anti_patterns: Connecting a Google Ads manager account instead of the client account that receives conversions.
Making multiple purchase actions primary for the same campaign and counting the same purchases twice.
Treating every Shopify order as an eligible Google Ads conversion regardless of payment or consent.

faq.question: Do I need Google Tag Manager?
faq.answer: No. The Shopify app embed loads the script through the store domain, and the app's checkout pixel reports purchases.

faq.question: Do I need Merchant Center?
faq.answer: Yes. Link Merchant Center to the Google Ads client account, then connect it in Product Metrics.

faq.question: When is a test order sent?
faq.answer: Product Metrics sends eligible test orders after Shopify marks them paid. The order must also meet the applicable consent requirements.

faq.question: Should I remove my existing Google Ads conversion actions?
faq.answer: No. Keep them while you compare results with the new secondary actions. Review your primary action before making changes to bidding goals.

faq.question: Why are the profit actions empty?
faq.answer: Check that your Shopify product costs are available and that you activated additional costs in Product Metrics.

faq.question: What happens after a refund or cancellation?
faq.answer: Shopify reports the change to Product Metrics, which adjusts the corresponding Google Ads conversion.
